```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
df <- readr::read_csv("/Users/reagangonzales/Documents/foodrescue/data-raw/Corrected_FRN_Collection_Form_Sep_30-Oct_19_2026.csv")
library(foodrescue)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
clean_df <- clean_food2(df)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
clean_data <- clean_df[['clean_data']]
tidy_data <- clean_df[['tidy_data']]
```

This is The Smith College Food Rescue Network's biweekly report for the week of October 19th. "Last 2 weeks" is defined as dates between October 5th to October 17th. Data was pulled in October 19th.

# Lbs of food rescued last 2 weeks

```{r}
tidy_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-05') |>
  pull(weight) |> 
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)
```

663.85 Ibs of food

# Total lbs of food rescued so far this semester 

```{r}
sum(tidy_data$weight)
```

1005.29 Ibs so far

# Pans collected the last 2 weeks

```{r}
clean_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-05') |>
  # calculate containers sums
  summarize(total_pans = sum(containers))
```

119 pans collected last 2 weeks

# Total pans collected so far this semester 

```{r}
clean_data |>
  # calculate containers sums
  summarize(total_pans = sum(containers))
```

155 pans collected so far this semester

# Most collected food/category last 2 weeks 

```{r}
tidy_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-05') |>
  group_by(type) |>
  summarise(total_weight = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_weight))
```

Most collected food last 2 weeks: Chicken 168 Ibs

# Summary

- 663.85 Ibs of food rescued last 2 weeks

- 1005.29 Ibs of food rescued so far this semester

- 119 pans collected last 2 weeks

- 155 pans collected so far this semester

- Chicken (168 Ibs) most collected food category last 2 weeks
